K1<4e^T and initial integral<9 imply Jshape<149e^T/2<128e^T; 4XR*e<mConst<4XR*e^(T+1).
H8, H4 and monotone XH give |D_I|/(XH)<=1024/X0I2, including the complete improper tail.
Gamma<=2; e^2<9; 1-exp(-a)>=a/2 for a<=1; log(1+Z)>=Z/3 for Z<=2; integrate y in [1/2,1] and v in [1,2].
Each of seven absolute terms is less than 2^(-bits-3); their sum is less than 2^-bits.
